messages.content: Check the installed public podcast-generation skill CLI error reporting without making a TTS network call. Locate its scripts/generate.py. Create a new temporary directory under /mnt/user-data/outputs and a valid script.json containing {"lines":[{"speaker":"male","paragraph":"Hello"}]}. Use Python subprocess.run with capture_output=True to invoke the actual script via sys.executable, --script-file and --output-file pointing to a fresh missing MP3. For that child only, copy os.environ and remove VOLCENGINE_TTS_APPID, VOLCENGINE_TTS_ACCESS_TOKEN, MINIMAX_API_KEY, and PODCAST_GENERATION_PROVIDER. Never print any credential values. Print the child returncode, stdout, stderr, and whether the MP3 exists and its size. As a control invoke the same CLI with no arguments and capture its returncode and stderr. Do not add credentials, patch the script, or substitute a mock. Report success only if audio actually exists; distinguish the operating-system return code from the generation outcome.
